summary: omp seats list their running subagents on the agent, as Claude and Codex seats do

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged. omp seats write the existing subagent claim kinds with the existing fields.

compatibility.detail: The omp extension sends a new subagent frame on the seat's channel. A channel from an older st ignores it. Older peers accept the claims, because their kinds and fields do not change. A running omp seat starts to report subagents after its next restart. For Codex and omp, the ledger now forgets a subagent's run count only after all of its runs have ended and been recorded, so a running subagent keeps its ID.

recovery.detail: Nothing to recover. The driver ends an omp subagent that has not reported for five minutes. A subagent that a stopped omp harness leaves open ends when its lease runs out.
